summary: Closed loop could not start: subagent dispatch is disabled in this session. Task and Agent both return 'No such tool available'. The programmatic fallback (yarn loop -> orchestrator/src, @cursor/sdk) has no CURSOR_API_KEY and would spawn Cursor cloud agents that push branches, which the user forbade. Zero of the six required team members were dispatched, so no stage ran. Loop state set to paused; no application code was written and no specialist was impersonated.
goal: Run the full closed-loop pipeline for the paid-duel region-eligibility server-side fix on /duel and /duel/chips (no client-side optimistic 'available' default, no flash, shared edge-compatible geo helper, fail-closed posture preserved).

feedback.message: Subagent dispatch tools (Task, Agent) are disabled for this session, so the required team (software-engineer, verifier, reviewer, security-reviewer, qa-acceptance, integrator) cannot be run. Per skills/closed-loop/team.md, doing the work in the orchestrator turn does not count as running the stage.
feedback.action: Re-enable subagent dispatch for this session and re-invoke /closed-loop, or explicitly authorize a direct (non-closed-loop) implementation with the understanding that the six quality gates will not run.

learnings.insight: Subagent dispatch can be disabled at the session level, in which case both Task and Agent fail with 'No such tool available'. The documented programmatic fallback (yarn loop / orchestrator/src) is not a substitute: it requires CURSOR_API_KEY and it spawns Cursor cloud agents that push branches.
learnings.action: Probe dispatch availability before writing loop/state.json as running. If neither Task nor Agent resolves, set status to paused with a blocker block and hand back to the user instead of silently absorbing the stages into the orchestrator turn.

learnings.insight: Iteration 1 dispatched 0 of 6 required team members; 0 stage handoffs were produced.
learnings.action: Treat dispatched.length === 0 at pause time as a hard environment blocker, not a scope problem, and report the tool names that failed.
